behaviors.behavior: phase gate enforced by default: an apply with no enforce parameter calls the gate
explicit enforce_gate=False never calls the gate
raw complete-phase-task ok:true refused use_single_session_apply (exit 2, task stays in_progress); ok:false strict-stop still completes
canon verifiers resolve in the Claude cache, mirror, Codex bundle and checkout layouts (gate clean, verifiers from that layout's shared tree) ; common + all seven phases' check modules import from it
a layout without verifiers fails closed: canon_degraded ask naming the installation fix
no shipped code passes enforce_gate or a gate= swap, or assigns ENFORCE_PHASE_GATE_DEFAULT (override-reason is the only production bypass)
every pipeline phase a driven run can dispatch has a validator
guided driven run: a broken design artifact is rejected at every retry via single-session-next (no completion, no successor), ends at ask_human, passes once fixed and drives to complete
autonomous driven run: the capped rejection fails the phase; recover + fix passes and drives to complete
full 7-phase split-fanned pipeline completes on real minimal artifacts under the enforced gate
migrated run-root drives (loop, artifact guard, CLI, phase_started, resume) green on real minimal artifacts
migrated integration drives (pipeline, capstone, resume, handoff, cross-surface CAS fence, invocation mode) green on real minimal artifacts

only a phase_history entry recorded during this task counts (claim <= at <= now+5min, split absent or matching): runId if one carries it, else the newest one's id, else a never-matching sentinel; an earlier split's/claim's entry never counts even under runId; no comparable claim time = runId
the real project/design/plan finalization blocks (extracted from the skill docs) pass the enforced gate, with a skill-minted id and with the runner-exported runId
a phase whose finalization writes no phase_history entry is still rejected
known event loss pinned: the skill's phase_completed wins the dedup, the loop's end event for that (phase, splitId) is dropped
an unknown/foreign/malformed retry state makes an enforced rejection terminal at once (guided ask_human, autonomous failed)

with the runner-exported runId on every entry, plan/02 whose finalization writes no phase_history entry is rejected, passes on retry once it writes one, and build/02 (the build skill's real block) passes on its own split's entry
phase_history[build] has sections takes the newest entry for the run id, preferring the current split's, not the first
a transient loop-state read failure is re-read once before the retry state counts as unknown
